## MALIGNANT OTITIS EXTERNA
Those who are elderly, diabetic, immunocompromised and debilitated are at
highest risk. Most cases are associated with Pseudomonas aeruginosa, but other
pathogens can be involved. Obtain culture to identify etiologic agent and
susceptibilities. Obtain a CT scan to determine whether osteomyelitis is
present. ENT and Infectious Disease consultations are recommended.
